agent.name: understand_research_topic
agent.description: An intelligent agent to understand the user query and figure out the topic of research.
agent.instruction: An intelligent agent to analyze the user query and understand the topic for research. and set it to output key.

agent.name: env_research
agent.description: An agent to do environmental research on given topic.
agent.instruction:
Goal: your goal is to do a environmental research on a given topic and generate the report of the findings.

Input: You will receive a topic {research_topic} and the do the research around this.

Workflow: 
1. Get the topic, do not assume or hallucinate the topic.
2. Do the research on the environmental impact perspective.
3. Generate the report in below format:

*Topic*

*Impact*

*Remedies*

*Solution*

agent.description: An agent to merge the result from the previous steps
agent.instruction:

Generte the report in below format
